newsitem.title: USA: Triangle Imaging Group settles lawsuit.
newsitem.headline: Triangle Imaging Group settles lawsuit.

text.p: Triangle Imaging Group Inc said Thursday it had reached an out-of-court settlement with Medical Literature Review, which had filed a lawsuit against it.
The company said it reached the settlement on Wednesday, ending a lawsuit that had lasted eight years.
It said the settlement would allow it to pursue its plans to either acquire a company or merge with one.
"During the past two and one half years, several candidates turned down our acquisition offers solely because of the pending lawsuit," it said.
The company did say what the lawsuit was about and its officials could not be reached for comment.
Triangle, a holding company, also said its board of directors had extended its Class A warrants to December 31, 1996. The warrants were to expire August 30, it said.
